text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober with a comfortable win!!
With this—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober achieves the Triple Tiara!!
The Mejiro family claims the glory of the Tiara once more!
We have witnessed a brand-new chapter of history being written right here!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
1st place...
I... won the Triple Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Dober's Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro, Doberrrrrrr!!!!
*sob* C-Congratulationsssss!!!!
Th-Thank you, *sniff*, for touching our heartssss!!!!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Dober-chaaaan!!!!
Seriously, seriously, seriously!
You looked so cool!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Dober! Dober! Dober!
Dober! Dober! Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(...I'm so happy. Happy, happy, happy!
No, I'm gonna cry—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Even so, urgh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Ramonu-san wasn't crying at all!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (That's why I've gotta stand tall and proud too!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...How wonderful.
Dear sister—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The three glorious tiaras.
To think that another girl would follow in your footsteps
and bring them all to the Mejiro family once more...
Fufu... Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The next time we face each other, you and I will—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I welcome her back as she leaves the thunderous cheers behind.
Her face was full of a sense of accomplishment...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Were you watching closely?
You better not have blinked."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Were you watching properly?
Do you truly understand?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: This is the Triple Tiara we seized together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: This is the Triple Tiara we seized together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …………Look.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"So, uh, just to bring it up again...
about that............"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: For believing in my strength—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, sharing in the joy, we took a new step forward toward our next challenge...!
